pairs.difference: A: mid-yellow ground with a modest light patch around the whistle; whistle is mid-grey with small dark mouth. B: whole card pushed very bright, with a pale halo behind the whistle that washes the pattern out nearly to white. Red-hot dark spots sit in the mouth slot and the lower mouthpiece.
pairs.fix: Keep the background one even mid-yellow with the pattern clearly visible. Remove the pale glow behind the whistle. Make the shading on the whistle soft with no deep red hot spots in the openings.

pairs.difference: A: rays run evenly across the whole card, with no bright patch behind the horn. B: a bright white burst sits in the centre behind the bugle loop and lifts the rays there. The tassels are small dark accents.
pairs.fix: Keep the rays the same strength across the whole card. Do not put a glowing burst behind the horn.

pairs.difference: A: dark muted red background with corners that darken, and a soft cup. B: bright orange-red glow around the cup, with a lighter halo and punchier whites, and a more saturated, hotter key.
pairs.fix: Use a flat red background with only a mild corner darkening. Draw no glow halo around the cup. Keep the cup's whites soft.

pairs.difference: A: lit from the side, and the background gets darker toward the right edge. B: a radial pale glow sits behind the basket and the handle, with a brighter, more even key.
pairs.fix: Make the purple wall a plain gradient with no bright halo behind the basket handle.

pairs.difference: A: strong light-and-dark split across the barrel, with a dark side and a lit side. B: evenly mid-grey staves, every hoop the same, with studs. Contrast is flatter and more uniform.
pairs.fix: Light the barrel from one side with a clear dark side and a lit side. Leave the hoops plain, without rows of studs.

pairs.difference: A: a bright pale glow sits behind the taxi's roof and hood, and the car is almost white. B: the rays are flatter and the car sits in a mid-grey surround.
pairs.fix: Remove the glow patch behind the car. Keep the rays and road at an even mid value.

pairs.difference: A: very bright and saturated, with a light shaft at the top and a deep black tent mouth. B: more muted, with darker corners and a soft light patch. Both are busy backgrounds.
pairs.fix: Tone down the sun shaft and keep the background values closer together.

pairs.difference: A: a bright fire glow lights the stones and the pot, with a clear dark pot mass against a lighter ground. B: muted, with dark corners and trees.
pairs.fix: Lower the fire glow and the contrast between the lit stones and the dark pot.

pattern: Generated cards put a bright glow or halo directly behind the hero, push the key brighter and hotter, and add sharp dark hot spots in openings. Real cards keep the background flat and the hero's local contrast gentler.
